Q1 (a) Define zeroth law of thermodynamics. [2]
 (b) When a system is taken from state a to state b along path acb, 100 J of heat flows into
the system and the system does 40 J of work.

(i) How much heat flows into the system along path aeb if the work done by the
system is 20 J?
(ii) The system returns from b to a along path bda. If the work done on the system
is 30 J, does the system absorb or liberate heat? How much?
[3]
